title: Four Winds
tagline: A crash game where the world shows you the risk.

status.idle: Place a bet to send the bird south.
status.flying: The bird is flying. Cash out before it goes down!
status.crashed: The bird went down at {mult}x ({cause}). Wager lost.
status.landed: Migration complete! The bird reached {mult}x and you won {amount}.

verify.title: Provably fair
verify.commit: Round commitment (SHA-256 of the secret seed)
verify.hint: After a round ends, verify it was fair.
verify.ok: Verified. The seed matches its commitment and the crash point recomputes to {mult}x.
verify.noCrypto: Verification needs a secure context (open the game at http://localhost).

nudge.realityCheck: Reality check: you have played {n} rounds (net {net} credits). Take a moment. Is this still fun?
nudge.lossStreak: You have lost {n} rounds in a row. A short break can help.
nudge.escalation: Your bet jumped sharply after a loss. Chasing losses rarely works. Consider a smaller bet.

ui.legend: Ghost birds are simulated cash-outs, for atmosphere only.

err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.insufficient_funds: Not enough credits for that wager.
err.round_in_progress: A round is already in progress.
err.bad_amount: Enter a wager between {min} and {max} credits.
err.bad_auto: Auto cash out must be at least 1.01x and no higher than this season's maximum.
err.busy: The server is busy. Please try again shortly.

disclaimer: Four Winds is a hackathon prototype played with virtual credits only. No real money is involved.
